question: What does a live Browserless Cloud request return on the Free plan without an account, and can a measured probe be registered for it?
why: Browserless Cloud is not keyless or trial: the Free Get Started link goes to /signup/email?plan=free and the signup asks for a work email plus a one-time code before an API token is issued. No account or code was requested, so no live probe value could be established without guessing; the vendor-published plan values are documented instead.
